title: Managing AI Agents: Comparing Manager-Led Teams and Solo Models on Physics and Mathematics Explainers
description: Study design, experimental software, scoring tools, and reports for a comparison of manager-led AI teams with solo models on physics and mathematics explainers. In the Qwen study, 81 of 84 planned runs were completed. The public archive excludes the private test questions, answer key, and raw run archive. Original software is licensed under MIT.
